items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated reference for generating one actual 3D VFX mesh for Cloudstitch. Create ONE elegant small curled smoke wisp, with a tapered rising S silhouette and two soft rolled-over edges, like a broad gouache brushstroke given shallow sculptural volume. Ivory cream upper planes, muted warm grey and desaturated teal underside, coarse visible painterly drybrush marks and just 3 value bands. It should have flowing empty gaps, narrow taper, soft asymmetric volume; NOT a cluster of balls, not low-poly facets, not a giant cloud. Three-quarter orthographic product view, fully visible isolated object centered. Emotionally warm hand-painted storybook airship art, matte chalky surface, delicate dark warm contour. Plain transparent background, no floor, no shadows, no sparks, no props, no writing or labels, no frame. Design should be a simple tangible shallow curved wisp for image-to-3D reconstruction, with internal brush texture painted onto the object; no ethereal glow.
